answer: Cheap replica keys cannot staff two scarce instruments in the same hour. The applicant locks 19.2 POA, lowers a 280-gram crystal plumb into gauging well CW-11 on the west rim of Redrock canyon, records a 16-second echo stamped 14:07, and redeems one numbered harvest ticket at orchard stall S-6 within 32 minutes. Stewards recompute SHA-256(well_id || echo_ms || ticket_no || address) and require a 13-minute travel gap. A reused well, a cloned ticket, or a short gap slashes 8.1 POA and parks the key for five epochs; 11.1 POA returns after four quiet epochs.
